info.name: Get the OpenAPI specification for the Onshape REST API.

params.name: version
params.description: Specify a version of Onshape from which the OpenAPI is generated. If '*' is specified in any of the version fields, that indicates any version if acceptable.

params.name: versionAlias
params.description: Version aliases based on the currently released version.

params.name: noFilter
params.description: Do not filter the specification at all.

params.name: includedTags
params.description: Return only operations with tags included in includedTags.

params.name: excludedTags
params.description: If an operation contains an excluded tag, it is not returned from this endpoint.

params.name: documentationStatuses
params.description: Only return endpoints that have the specified documentation status. Default is to return all the endpoints the user should have access to.

params.name: restUserRole
params.description: The REST user role for which this spec is requested.

params.name: operationIds
params.description: Only return operations with specified ids.

params.name: excludedOperationIds
params.description: Do not return operations with specified ids.

items.docs: The Onshape API OpenAPI specification is returned in the JSON format.

info.name: Get the list of tags in the Onshape OpenAPI specification.

items.docs: Tags are used to group operations. For example, `Document` groups operations on documents.
